DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 時が来た

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: キキキッ、そう狼狽える必要は無い

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私の完璧な計画が整ったという知らせだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いよいよ、この羽沼マコト様の……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いや、我々の偉大な物語が始まるのだ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さあ、シャーレの先生よ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 万魔殿で待っているぞ、キキキッ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: えっと……万魔殿に来てほしい、って意味だよね……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: キキッ。久しぶりだな、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: おはよう、マコト

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: このマコト様からモモトークが届いても、まったく動揺を見せないその反応

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さすがは私が認めただけの者だ、ますます気に入ったぞ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ありがとうございます……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 雑談はここまでにして、さっそく本題だ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日、先生に連絡した理由は――

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……うむ、もう着いたのか

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今日はどこに出かけてるの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: どこって、シャーレに決まっているじゃないか

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: え、シャーレに？今？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: キキキッ。続きは直接、顔を合わせて話すとしよう

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: あ、あの……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: キキキッ、キシシシシ！流石は私だ！！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 前に言っていたメーカーの取扱店舗を見つけたぞ、イロハ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: マコト様の辞書に不可能の文字は存在しないと、また証明されてしまったな！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さあ！この偉大なマコト様にひれ伏すがいい！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……えっと、急にどうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ん？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: おっと

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 通知を見て何かと思ったが……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: なるほど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: イロハと間違えて先生に送ってしまったようだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……あの、二人は普段どういう会話をしているの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 日常会話だが……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ともかく、ミスは謝ろう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そういえば、先生も今週末は休みだったな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: キキキッ、お互い楽しい週末にしよう

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: あ、うん。マコトも楽しんでね……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 時が来た

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: デジャブのような……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 前にも同じメッセージをもらったような……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: キシシッ、そうだったか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 前に、このマコト様が進めているビジネスを紹介しただろう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いよいよ、お披露目の準備が整ったぞ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それで連絡したのだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 思っていたよりも早くて驚いたよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 早速だが、今日は空いているか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もちろん、時間ならあるけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: キキキッ。よし！では、すぐ迎えに行こう！

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 드디어 때가 무르익은 듯하군. 샬레의 선생.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 크크큭. 당황할 거 없다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그저 내 완벽한 계획을 위한 모든 준비가 끝났다는 뜻이니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘을 기점으로 마침내 나 하누마 마코토 님의…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아니, 우리들이 함께하는 위대한 첫걸음이 시작되는 거다!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 자아, 샬레의 선생이여.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 오늘 만마전에서 기다리고 있겠다. 키키킥.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 으음, 만마전을 방문해달라는 이야기지……? 알았어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 크큭. 안녕하신가. 선생.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 응, 안녕. 마코토.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이 마코토 님의 모모톡을 받고도 요만큼도 동요하지 않는 그 반응.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 과연, 그야말로 내가 인정한 자답군. 마음에 들어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 어… 음, 고맙습니다…?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 잡설은 이만하고 본론이다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 이렇게 선생에게 연락한 이유는 다름이 아니라.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: …음? 벌써 도착했나.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 어? 도착했다니?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아, 별거 아니다. 지금 막 샬레 앞에 도착했을 뿐이니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 응…? 샬레에? 지금?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 키히히힛. 좋아, 그럼 본론은 직접 얼굴을 맞대고 이야기하도록 하지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 저기, 잠깐. 저기요, 마코토?!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 크크큭. 키싯. 키키키킷!! 역시 이 몸이로군!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 저번에 말했던 메이커의 판매점을 찾는 데 성공해 냈다! 이로하!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 역시 이 마코토 님에게 불가능 따윈 없단 것이 또 한 번 증명되고야 말았군!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 자! 이 몸의 위대함에 넙죽 엎드려라! 요 녀석!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: …어, 미안. 마코토. 갑자기 무슨 이야기인지 모르겠는데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 으으음?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아. 이런.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 예상과 다른 평범한 반응에 나도 모르게 깜짝 놀랐다만.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 과연… 선생이었나.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이로하에게 보낼 모모톡을 잘못 보냈군.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: …저기 평소에 둘이서 대체 무슨 모모톡을 주고받는 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그냥 일상 회화를 나눌 뿐이다만?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어쨌거나 실수한 건 내 사과하지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러고 보니 선생도 이번 주말은 휴일이었던가.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 크큭. 그럼 좋은 주말 보내도록.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 어, 응. 마코토도, 좋은 주말 보내….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 드디어 때가 무르익은 듯하군. 선생이여.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 이건… 데자뷔…?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 저번에도 같은 말을 본 적이 있는 듯한….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 키시싯. 당황할 거 없다. 선생.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 저번엔 단순히 이 몸이 막 시작했던 사업을 소개하는 자리였다면.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘은 바로 그 사업의 완성이 코앞에 다가온 기념으로

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 새롭게 선생에게 그것을 보여주고자 연락한 것이니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 벌써 시간이 그렇게 된 거구나.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 말이다만, 오늘 시간은 비어있나?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 물론 시간이라면 있지만…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 키히히힛. 좋다. 그럼 바로 데리러 가도록 하지!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The time has come, Sensei of Schale.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Kihehe. Don't be scared.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The preparations of my master plan are complete.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: As of today, I, the Great Makoto...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No. WE shall take this first, great step together!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Now then, Sensei of Schale.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I shall be waiting for you at the Pandemonium Society. Kihehe.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Hm. So you want me to visit the Pandemonium Society? All right.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heh heh. How do you do, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oh. Hey, Makoto.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You are not shaken after receiving a MomoTalk from me, Makoto?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: As expected from one of your stature. I approve.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Uh... Err... Thank you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Enough chatter. To the point.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The reason I reached out to you today is because

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Wait. Where are you? I've arrived.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You've arrived?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I just arrived in front of Schale.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What? At Schale? Right now?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Kihehe. Now, let us have our discussion face to face.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Now hold on. Excuse me? Makoto?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Kihehe. Heh heh heh! As expected of the great Makoto!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I succeeded in finding that retailer I mentioned last time, Iroha!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Once again, I, the Great Makoto, have shown that nothing is impossible for me!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Bow, you rascal! Prostrate yourself before my greatness!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Uh, sorry, Makoto. I have no clue what you're talking about.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hmm?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh. You did not see anything you just read.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: My machinations are incomprehensible to even the sharpest minds.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That includes you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Only the likes of Iroha can handle such a message. So don't read it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Is that what you two usually talk about on MomoTalk?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Um, small talk?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyway, forget what you saw.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Come to think of it, you were supposed to be off this weekend too.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heh. Have a great weekend, then.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Uh, sure. You have a great weekend too, Makoto.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The time has come, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Is this déjà vu?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I feel like I've seen this exact message before.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Kihehe. No need to panic, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Last time, I was introducing you to my new enterprise.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Today marks the near-completion of that particular project

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: and you shall be my witness, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I can't believe it's already been that long.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: When are you available?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I have some time, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Kihehe. Good. Then I'll head on over to pick you up!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ในที่สุดก็ถึงเวลาแล้ว คุณครูจาก
ชาเล่ต์

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หึหึหึ ไม่ต้องตกใจหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ตอนนี้เราเตรียมการทุกอย่าง
เพื่อแผนการที่สมบูรณ์แบบของเรา
ไว้พร้อมแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
นับตั้งแต่วันนี้ไป ท่านฮานุมะ
มาโคโตะผู้นี้...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่สิ นับเป็นจุดเริ่มต้นที่ยิ่งใหญ่
ของพวกเราต่างหาก!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้น... คุณครูจากชาเล่ต์

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เราจะรออยู่ที่แพนเดโมเนียม โซไซตี้
ก็แล้วกันนะ หึหึหึ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
อืม จะให้ครูไปหาที่แพนเดโมเนียม
โซไซตี้ใช่มั้ย...? ก็ได้ๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หึหึ สวัสดีคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ... ว่าไง มาโคโตะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ได้รับข้อความจากท่านมาโคโตะผู้นี้
แต่ก็ยังแสดงท่าทางที่นิ่งเฉยได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สมแล้วที่เป็นผู้ที่เรานับถือ ถูกใจจริงๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เอ่อ... อืม ขอบใจนะ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เลิกคุยเรื่องไร้สาระเท่านี้ แล้วมา
เข้าเรื่องกันเถอะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เหตุผลที่เราติดต่อมาหาคุณครู
ในวันนี้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวนะ...? เรามาถึงแล้วละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: โอ๊ะ? มาแล้วงั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อืม ไม่ใช่เรื่องใหญ่อะไร เราเพิ่งมาถึง
ด้านหน้าชาเล่ต์เมื่อครู่นี้

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ว่าไงนะ...? อยู่ที่หน้าชาเล่ต์เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คิคิกคิกคิก... ดีละ ถ้างั้นธุระที่ว่า
เอาไว้คุยกันต่อหน้าก็แล้วกัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: นี่ เดี๋ยวก่อนสิ เดี๋ยวสิ มาโคโตะ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คิกคิกคิก คิคิ คิกๆๆๆ!!
สมกับเป็นเราจริงๆ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เราหาร้านผู้ผลิตที่บอกไปคราวก่อน
ได้สำเร็จแล้ว! อิโรฮะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
นี่คือข้อพิสูจน์ชั้นยอดว่าไม่มีอะไร
ที่ท่านมาโคโตะผู้นี้ทำไม่ได้ยังไงล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เอ้า! รีบหมอบและศิโรราบต่อความ
ยิ่งใหญ่ของเราซะสิ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
เอ่อ... โทษทีนะมาโคโตะ
ครูไม่เข้าใจที่พูดมาเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ๊ะ แย่ล่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เจอปฏิกิริยาตอบสนองทั่วๆ ไปแบบนี้
เราก็ตกใจเหมือนกันนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวนะ... แชตของคุณครูนี่เอง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เราส่งข้อความผิดมาให้คุณครูแทน
อิโรฮะสินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ปกติพวกเธอส่งข้อความ
คุยอะไรกันเนี่ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็แค่คุยเรื่องทั่วไปในชีวิตประจำวัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ยังไงเราก็ต้องขอโทษเรื่องที่ส่ง
ข้อความผิดด้วย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
พอมานึกๆ ดูแล้ว สุดสัปดาห์นี้คุณครูก็
หยุดสินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คิกคิก... ขอให้เป็นวันหยุดที่ดี

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
อื้อ ขอให้เป็นสุดสัปดาห์ที่ดี
ของมาโคโตะเหมือนกัน...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ในที่สุดก็ถึงเวลาแล้วละ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แบบนี้มัน... เดจาวูชัดๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
เหมือนเคยเห็นข้อความแบบนี้
มาก่อนเลยแฮะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คิกๆๆ ไม่ต้องตกใจหรอก คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เมื่อครั้งที่แล้วเราแนะนำธุรกิจ
ที่ได้ริเริ่มไปอย่างง่ายๆ แล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
และวันนี้เพื่อฉลองความสำเร็จ
ของธุรกิจ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เราเลยติดต่อมาเพื่อจะแสดง
ให้คุณครูเห็นไงล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เวลาผ่านไปขนาดนี้แล้วเหรอเนี่ย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ยังไงก็เถอะ วันนี้ว่างรึเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ก็พอว่างอยู่นะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คิกคิกคิกๆ ดีละ ถ้างั้นเราจะไปรับ
เดี๋ยวนี้เลย!

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 時機似乎終於成熟了，夏萊的老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘻嘻嘻，不必慌張

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只是代表我的完美計畫已經準備就緒而已

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 以今天為起點，我羽沼真琴大人終於……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不，我們將一起踏出偉大的第一步

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 來吧，夏萊的老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我今天會在萬魔殿等你，嘻嘻嘻

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 唔嗯，是要我到萬魔殿的意思吧……？我知道了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘻嘻，你好啊。老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 你好呀，真琴

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 收到我的MomoTalk居然絲毫不動搖

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 果然是我認可的人，我很滿意

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯……謝謝誇獎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 閒聊就先說到這裡，進入正題吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天之所以聯絡老師，為的就是

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……嗯？已經到了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯？已經到了？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊，沒什麼。我剛到夏萊了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯……？夏萊？現在？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘻嘻嘻。我們直接碰面再談正題吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 等等，真琴！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘻嘻，嘰嘻嘻嘻嘻！！我果然厲害！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我成功找到上次說的製造商的販售店了！伊呂波！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 果然，這再次證明我真琴大人沒有辦不到的事！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 來！向偉大的我叩拜吧你這傢伙！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……抱歉，真琴。我不知道你突然在說什麼

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊，哎呀

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這意料淡定的反應也讓我有點驚訝

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 果然……是老師啊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 本來要傳給伊呂波的MomoTalk傳錯人了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 你們平常到底在傳什麼訊息……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只是閒話家常而已

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不過是我不對，我道歉

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 對了，老師這週末也放假嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘻嘻，祝老師週末愉快

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 呃，嗯。也祝真琴有個美好的週末……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 時機似乎終於成熟了，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這難道是……既視感？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 總覺得之前也看過一樣的訊息……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘻嘻嘻，不必慌張

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果說上次只是單純介紹我剛起步的事業

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼今天就是為了紀念事業即將大功告成

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 為了讓老師見證那一刻才聯絡你

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 原來已經到了這個時候了啊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以今天有空嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 有是有啦……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘻嘻嘻。好，那我馬上去接你！
